header: The browser's ask: POST the typed line to /api/tools/intent (src/app/api/tools/intent/route.ts) and get a checked utility id back, or null. It never throws: any failure (offline, not signed in, a slow answer, the AI switched off) is simply "no answer", and the search box searches as it always did. It sends nothing but the one line.

symbols.name: askIntent
